Squid is a cross-chain DeFi application that enables token swaps across different blockchains. Squid is built on the Axelar network, which it uses for cross-chain messaging.

Nexus Mutual is a decentralized insurance mutual that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Nexus Mutual uses the NXM token as its membership and staking token. Nexus Mutual relies on member voting for the assessment of insurance claims.

Etherisc is a decentralized insurance platform built on public blockchains. Etherisc provides a framework for creating and running insurance products as smart contracts.

Bridge Mutual is a decentralized insurance protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Bridge Mutual offers coverage against smart contract failures. Bridge Mutual is funded by liquidity providers who deposit capital into coverage pools.
